scene information.what: 猛冲莽杀的捷风吐槽奶妈拖节奏，反转发现自己全程靠贤者奶命，搞笑反差收尾

scene.speaker: 捷风
scene.content: 最后那个残血我直接秒了，你跟这么快干嘛，拖节奏啊！

actions.motion_detail: Shoulders relaxed, one hand waving impatiently, fingertips still buzzing from gun recoil
Leans against the porthole, calm expression with a faint smile
